title: LoggingLine
description: One structured JSON log line. Packages log only through host.log, which stamps and redacts before a line ever reaches this shape; a raw log call never bypasses it. See platform plan 2.1 and docs/ENGINEERING.md > Logging.

package_id.description: The package that logged this line, or null for a core-emitted line.

context.description: The turn or op context this line belongs to, for the Developer tools timeline.

message.description: Redacted by host.log before this line exists; never a secret, token, PII value, or transcript.

fields.description: Structured extras, also redacted by host.log.
